authoritativeRules: Avatars attach to durable player records, never seats, room memberships, or active matches.
Unauthenticated queries for room avatars are rejected; room members receive only the current participants' chosen portraits.
Lobby roster provides Change avatar beside the viewer's own name.
Table options provides Change avatar during active writing, voting, reveal, and finished match phases.
The avatar picker maintains single radio navigation, stable short labels with accessible full names, a pinned save button, and a scrollable choice area.
Cancelling or escaping from the picker preserves the existing selection and returns focus to the trigger.
Chosen avatars persist across browser reloads, explicit table departures, and new room joins.
Local complete resets clear player avatars along with games and rooms without dropping cards or deployment configuration.
